method: Independent read-only code review plus independent Chromium reproduction by reviewer; separate focused red/green regressions by implementer

findings.problem: Context loss during base.decode hid the full fallback after loading completed
findings.resolution: After decoding, keep full fallback when fatal/lost. Reproduced failing before and passing after.

findings.problem: Restarting A4 profile while running retained its previous clock
findings.resolution: Stop the prior loop before resetting active time and restarting. Reproduced failing before and passing after.
